findings.title: Recovery report falsely denies A-side field-name diagnostics
findings.evidence: A source-map shape output prints evidenceForm, planCurrentState, requiredReadPresence, stage1Generation and derivedFrom keys. Schema output also contains prohibited proxy tokens as explicit prohibitions. The claim that these names appear only in the task prompt and never diagnostics is false.
findings.consequence: Narrows the clean-input narrative. Structural names/types and prohibition text are visible; no per-fact forbidden state values, proxy assignment, registry contents or peer marks are identified. No affirmative scientific L-2 breach established from these names alone. Unlike B, A did not print false/zero occurrence values in this shape call.
findings.disposition: Carry qualified actual-access assessment. Original A report makes no categorical no-vocabulary assertion; the error is in recovery prose/matrix.

findings.title: Client-record proof ceiling and full L-2 boundary
findings.evidence: Client records positively establish model routing, fresh delegation, 905 allowed visible facts on each side and distinct original judgments. No provider-authenticated inference receipt, complete API-context attestation or independent OS access telemetry is supplied.
findings.consequence: Observable bilateral independence is supported with limitations; unlogged access is not universally excluded. Missing receipts alone prove neither a breach nor a requirement to rerun. Documentary PASS does not waive mandatory independence or open science eligibility.

findings.title: B copied-file birth times are not checkout-delivery times
findings.evidence: B assembles scratch marks at 19:23:35Z and later copies with cp -p, with successful repository transfer recorded by 19:25:11.854Z. Repository marks birth/mtime remain 19:23:35.857925Z.
findings.consequence: Birth timestamps corroborate artifact age but do not independently date delivery into the shared checkout. Corrected observable ordering still puts A freeze first; B was generating judgments while A marks existed, so independence requires actual-read inspection, not freeze order alone.
